scenarios.name: Successful login with valid credentials navigates to dashboard
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and correct password
the user clicks the submit button
then: the user is redirected to the dashboard

scenarios.name: Login blocked with authentication error for incorrect password
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
the user clicks the submit button
then: the user remains on the login page
an authentication error message is displayed

scenarios.name: Login blocked with required field errors when both fields are empty
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user leaves both email and password fields empty
the user clicks the submit button
then: required field validation errors are shown for both email and password fields

scenarios.name: Login blocked with format error for invalid email format
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a malformed email address and a valid password
the user clicks the submit button
then: an email format validation error is displayed

scenarios.name: Login blocked with required field error when only email is missing
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user leaves the email field empty and enters a valid password
the user clicks the submit button
then: a required field error is shown only for the email field

scenarios.name: Login blocked with required field error when only password is missing
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and leaves the password field empty
the user clicks the submit button
then: a required field error is shown only for the password field

scenarios.name: Password field masks entered characters for security
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user types a password into the password field
then: the password characters are masked and not visible as plain text

scenarios.name: Login form is accessible with correct ARIA labels and keyboard navigation
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user navigates the form using only the keyboard
the user inspects ARIA roles and labels on form elements
then: all form fields and the submit button are reachable via Tab key
email, password fields and submit button have appropriate ARIA labels or roles
